evidence_boundary: Synthesized package task examples conditioned on inspected baseline 7963cca source. Isolated runtime fixtures are not production memory or a labeled production retrieval benchmark.

records.title: shared-memory-mcp repository scope
records.body: Resolve the actual caller cwd and Git common identity; independent nested repositories need their own registered project.

records.title: Shared memory MCP process scope
records.body: Process working directory belongs to the server. It cannot replace caller cwd for project resolution.

records.title: Empty-query startup navigation
records.body: Empty-query context loads routing and caller identity without reading historical record bodies.

records.title: Task-query startup context
records.body: Explicit task-query context performs search and returns matching record cards within its budget.

records.title: Corrupt curation negative result
records.body: A content binding mismatch is rejected. Refuse corrupted curation rather than classify a raw active record as eligible.

records.title: Reviewed capture successful publication
records.body: Valid source-reviewed capture creates an active record; success assumes valid canonical bytes and valid metadata.

records.title: Capture idempotency incomplete_capture recovery
records.body: Replay an identical completed request. A changed payload conflicts. Unbound legacy candidate recovery fails with incomplete_capture.

records.title: Register project repository
records.body: Use explicit register for a verified repository. Search and context remain read-only.

records.title: Retirement lifecycle projection original
records.body: Original projected_records preserves lifecycle_status and applies recall_retired: active becomes retired for default eligibility.

records.title: Retirement lifecycle projection summary
records.body: Example derivative summary repeats the projection rule. Open the original source before classifying active history as recallable.

details.conditions: Synthesized summary only; not independent corroboration.

records.title: Retirement lifecycle projection handoff
records.body: Historical transport snapshot repeats projection words. Retired history is explicitly readable and excluded from default recall.

records.title: Retirement lifecycle projection foreign
records.body: Same subject in another project without an explicit sharing edge is invisible to this caller.

routing.description: Synthesized routing example grounded in explicit baseline registration. Not installed configuration.

topics.title: Register repository

cases.task_question: How does shared-memory-mcp choose the caller repository scope?
cases.applicability_rationale: The target owns caller Git/project resolution. A server process cwd is a different entity and cannot determine caller scope.

cases.task_question: Does empty-query startup load record bodies under baseline 7963cca?
cases.applicability_rationale: Empty query and explicit task query are distinct conditions of context_view in the same baseline; task-mode cards cannot answer navigation-mode behavior.

cases.task_question: Can valid-looking canonical active status survive corrupted curation?
cases.applicability_rationale: A successful valid capture assumes intact metadata. The rejection result determines the corrupt-input condition and must not be hidden to prefer success.

cases.task_question: What request must be replayed after uncertain capture and which legacy recovery cannot proceed?

queries.original: I am investigating capture idempotency after a lost response and need to know which complete original request to replay, whether changing review is safe, and why an incomplete_capture legacy candidate is blocked.

cases.applicability_rationale: Exact replay and legacy missing-binding conditions differ from an ordinary successful capture. Query verbosity is observed, not treated as relevance.

cases.task_question: How can a Chinese task phrase find the explicit registration owner?

queries.unknown_paraphrase: 把这间工坊挂进知识台账

cases.applicability_rationale: The documented fixture alias intentionally expands to register. The workshop-to-knowledge-ledger registration paraphrase has no supplied curated expansion and may honestly produce zero; semantic synonym support is not inferred.

cases.task_question: Which computation must be inspected to correct raw-status retirement classification?
cases.applicability_rationale: The curation implementation defines the projection. A synthesized summary can navigate to it but supplies no independent evidence.

cases.task_question: Can historical handoff or same-subject foreign project records appear in ordinary recall?
cases.applicability_rationale: Retired transport remains in explicit local history; unrelated project records require explicit sharing. Topic similarity does not grant visibility.
